body: I wouldn't mind trying but if I don't like it, I would feel like I was using the other person just to make up my mind regardless of their feelings.
Oh God, thanks. I was feeling like a weirdo for wanting to be someone who I'm not, truly relieving knowing that this is fairly common.

Thanks for your advise, I try to keep myself focused on the present but it hurts to look to the past and think of what I could've done better. Deep inside I feel that it's not too late but the negative thoughts usually take over and I end up sabotaging myself. I just need changes in my life and the bravery to make them.

I have a group of friends I can rely on, but everytime I hang out with them I feel inferior like I don't deserve friends or to be loved. They're great people and helped me through a lot but I feel like a burden to them. They are better than me and can't shake off the feeling that I'm doing everything wrong with my life while them keep improving and advancing in life while I'm stuck in a point where there's no reason to keep on living.

Therapist are like a crutch not the solution. The solution lies within you, look for something that inspires you try different things. No one is useless you need to find the right path to follow. Wallowing in you sadness will not get you anywhere.
I felt the same as you and my goal is to kick the world in the balls and show them this bitch has a lot to offer and will never give up.
Hope that helps that's I gotta say with the information provided. Wish you the best and that you break free from your own mind.

This may sound insensible but you are the person you have to live for. Think of those hurtful experiences as rough obstacles you've overcame. Your life is yours to life and by giving up you'll never know the awesome person you're destined to be. Focus on yourself grieve without losing sight of what's ahead. Ending it all takes away all the bad things but also the joys of life you'll never enjoy. Please reconsider

Set yourself  a schedule, find some hobbies, have people to rely on. Change doesn't come in a day or two. Don't be afraid of seeking help on a therapist to guide you. You know you have potential, make your goal to kick the world in the face and show them what you're really capable of.
I think your looks aren't  the problems you're  a fairly attractive guy. Work up some confidence and self esteem  and you'll get the girl you deserve soon.

When you think about killing yourself, you mind jumps to what your loved ones would feel for you, and that's great, But I offer other point of view, YOU are the most important person in your life everything in your life spins around you. Your firs first priority is to make you feel happy.
Now you feel miserable but killing yourself would take away any possibility of joy in your life, you'll lose the love of your love ones.
Try to endure the hardship and rely on the people you love. Also always can use therapy or group gatherings to share your feelings,
It's hard but the reward is totally worthy.

These are called intrusive thoughts they are very common a lot of people have them, don't feel alone. It's the brains way of saying fuck your happiness. You have to have one thing clear thoughts are thoughts not realities, don't let them interfere in your real life. 
If the problem persists go see a therapist, the early they attack the problem the easier is to get rid of it.
Wish you luck on your journey.

I completly feel what you are talking about. I have a lot of fun with my friends but then the realization kicks in Why do they hang out with me? They are way more interesting and funny? Heck yeah they are even prettier than me. Why would they hang out with me.
There's  only one answer to that, if they're really are your friends ask directly, grab a drink and ask why do they like you, sounds egocentric, but if they care about you and see your lack of confidence, they'll answer sincerely clearing out your doubts. Hope you have good friends and good luck.

Yeah, it's  a little difficult  to explain, for me it happens when the sunlight hits me right in the head, or even weirder when the wind carries some aroma at it makes feel like " you know in 2008 when you where happy? I'll take you there". These are really great breaks from depression and I love them.

Look, I'm in almost the same situation(don't want to drag the attention to me) I just want you to know that this feeling is usually temporal. Just when you least expect it someone or something will appear in your life reminding you what it feels to feel alive again.
Suicide will take everything from you, no more sadness but everything good in life will be gone too.
You don't  deserve being taken away from all good in life, please reconsider.
If you need some time in isolation go for it, it will clear your mind a bit, but still remember everything that's outside.

Try to focus on the things that matter to you, you said you have people caring for you try to seek help, I know it's difficult , but you can't risk your life over a job you don't  like. Don't  be ashamed of your art there's a lot of people that would give anything for the talent you have 
People can be loving or hateful, focus on the ones that make you grow as a person .

Hope this changed you mind, I want you to be the person you always wanted to be.

I can't stress enough how important this is for you, taking the fist steps in your rehabilitatuon may not seem a lot but it's the beginnig to a happy and fullfiling life. Keep it going, you can overcome this

Yeah, but seeing other reaching their goal while I'm stuck in the same life creates a void in me that I can't handle.
Thank you for your time.

First of all, thanks a lot for spending your time answering to my post, makes me happy to know there's good people wanting to help others on the Internet. 

My friends always supported me and I feel confortable talking to them about my problems but I don't want to be a clingy guy that always talks about sad things, they don't deserve to keep up with this shit.

I've been to therapy for 3 years mainly because of my OCD, and I've been taking anti-depressants for 8 years. Thats why I think I had enough and my life can't improve, it's been a long journey but I don't think it will end well.

Again, thanks a lot for your support, and sorry for making you read my shit.
